chalisa.do1: Fixing my meditation on the feet of Śrī Guru and remembering Saccidānanda, I recite the Śyāma Chālīsā, composing it in chaupāī verse.
chalisa.cau1: Worshipping Śyāma, Śyāma, again and again, one crosses the ocean of worldly existence with ease. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: There is no other god equal to him; none is so merciful to the humble, nor so generous a giver. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: He is the good son of Bhīma, born of Ahilavatī; in some places he is called Bhīma's grandson. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: All these stories are true, in different kalpas; do not suppose the least contradiction in them. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Barbarīka is an incarnation of Viṣṇu; for the sake of his devotees he took a human body. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: He is the beloved of Vasudeva and Devakī, the darling of Mother Yaśodā and Nanda. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: He is Madhusūdana, Gopāla and Murāri, the youth of Vraja who held up Govardhana. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: He is Siyārāma, Śrī Hari and Govinda, the protector of the humble, Śrī Bāla Mukunda. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: He is Dāmodara, Raṇachoṛa and Bihārī; he is the Lord, the lord of Dvārakā, the slayer of Khara. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: In the form of Narahari, the man-lion, the Lord dear to Prahlāda tore open the pillar and killed Hiraṇyakaśipu. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: He is Rādhā's beloved and Rukmiṇī's husband, the beloved of the gopīs and the slayer of Kaṃsa. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: He was called the enchanter of the mind and the stealer of hearts; he stole butter again and again and ate it. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: He is the bearer of the flute, the lord of the Yadus, dark as a rain-cloud; he is Kṛṣṇa, the delightful purifier of the fallen. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: He is the lord of māyā, the lord of Lakṣmī, the Lord; he is Puruṣottama, Keśava, the lord of the world. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: He is the lord of the universe, the light of the three worlds, the friend of the humble and the protector of his devotees. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: No one has found the Lord's secret; Śeṣa, Śiva and the greatest of sages have grown weary. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Nārada, Sarasvatī, the ṛṣis and the great yogīs all repeat Śyāma, Śyāma, without ceasing. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: The learned tried but could not count them; his names are boundless, fathomless and endless. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Brother, in every creation and every age he takes incarnation and gives joy to his devotees. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Reflect in your heart and see: if one worships Śyāma, there is deliverance. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: He saved the courtesan who taught a parrot his name; I give myself to the devotion of the Bhīla woman (Śabarī). ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: The chaste Ahalyā, Gautama's wife, became a sorrowful stone under a curse. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Receiving the dust of Śyāma's feet for ever, she went and reached her husband's world. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Ajāmila and Sadana the butcher reached the supreme state by the power of the name. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Whoever has Śyāma's name for his support obtains happiness, and all his sorrow goes far away. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Lovely-eyed Śyāma is most beautiful; a crown of peacock feathers is on his head and a yellow garment on his body. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The Vaijayantī garland graces his neck; his incomparable beauty delights the hearts of his devotees. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Remember Śyāma, Śyāma, day and night, at evening, at midday and at dawn. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: For whoever has Śyāma for the charioteer of his chariot, the stones on that path are cleared away. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Śyāma's devotee was never defeated anywhere; when distress fell on him, he called on Śyāma. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Tongue, drink the nectar of Śyāma's name; live in the care of Śyāma's name. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: There will be the happiness and enjoyments of the world, and in the end the joy of union with Śyāma. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: The Lord Śyāma is dark of body, but fair of heart, simple and guileless. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Śyāma is the benefactor of saints and devotees; he destroys heavy diseases, faults and sins. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: The devotee who calls on his name with love is dear to Śyāma. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: The Lord who dwells in Mathurā is at Khāṭū; he is the Supreme Brahman, complete and imperishable. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: He played his flute, filling it with a melody like nectar, and in all four directions, wherever they were, many heard it. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Old and young, all the women and men there were, were enchanted to hear the notes of the flute. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Running and running, all went and reached Khāṭū, where Śyāma Kanhāī is. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever beheld Śyāma's form was freed from the fear of worldly existence. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: Charming, dark-hued Śyāma, who took the body of Barbarīka, fulfil your devotee's wish, and do not delay.
